title.en: Defending autonomy does not settle property debates
title.zh: 维护自主不能自动解决财产权争论

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：在虚构制度讨论中，一位成年人同意把自己完成的一段文字用于某次和平活动，机构又打算将其用于另一项活动。可以分别询问最初许可包括什么、用途是否改变，以及讨论的是个人同意还是其他尚未说明的义务。这些问题帮助解释命题，不决定真实文字的法律归属。较高均分也不能替你证明每项安排都自愿，或把一个有限许可解释成所有用途都获准。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene for institutional discussion, an adult permits a text they prepared to be used in one peaceful activity. An agency proposes another use. Separate the original permission, changed purpose and any unspecified duty. These questions clarify a proposition without determining real legal ownership. A higher mean certifies no voluntary arrangement and expands no limited permission to every use.

title.en: Make a qualification explicit without choosing a camp
title.zh: 写清限定条件，不急于选阵营

paragraphs.zh: 可写一张虚构讨论卡：“已给的许可”“尚未给出的许可”“命题遗漏的条件”。问：“我是在支持一个原则，还是已经补入题目没有的事实？”不需要写真实身份或要求他人表态；同一份公开指南可供不同观点的人各自澄清限定。
paragraphs.en: Draft an invented discussion card with permission given, permission still absent and an omitted condition. Ask whether you endorse a principle or have supplied an unstated fact. Use no real identity or demanded declaration; people with different views can use the same public guide to clarify qualifications.

paragraphs.zh: 这些新增素材由费马编辑部原创，可只读或留作私人草稿。四个议题各八条，表达对假设政治原则的同意程度；每组四条相反键向用6减原值。八条数字完整才显示所属调整和与两位小数均分，NA不补中立，四份全文始终开放。题本没有固定近期时段，不观察日常合作，不证明法律结论或政治身份。公开指南可单独分享，不包含个人答案、总和或均分。
paragraphs.en: These new FermatMind Editorial prompts allow reading or a private draft. Four eight-item topics concern agreement with hypothetical political principles; four opposite-facing items in each use six minus the response. Eight numeric answers are needed for a topic’s adjusted sum and two-decimal mean. NA receives no neutral filling and all four full guides stay open. The bank specifies no recent period, observes no everyday cooperation and proves no legal conclusion or political identity. Public guides can be shared separately without answers, sums or means.

title.en: Supporting choice is not accepting every existing bargain
title.zh: 支持选择，不等于认可所有既有交易

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构机构让两位成年人选择合作方式，文件写着“可自由选择”，却没有说明替代方式是否实际可用、重要条件是否披露，也未交代拒绝的后果。形式上出现选择一词，不能补足这些信息。有人可能赞成自愿合作原则，同时对这个例子的事实保持未知；另一人可能对相关制度保障仍有原则性保留。均分不能替两人判定同一份真实约定是否自愿，也不评定谁更好合作。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented institution offers two adults a “free choice” of cooperation. The text leaves alternatives, material disclosures and consequences of refusal unspecified. The word choice supplies none of those facts. One reader can endorse voluntary cooperation while withholding a judgment here; another can retain a principled concern about safeguards. The mean decides no real agreement’s voluntariness and ranks nobody’s cooperativeness.

title.en: Compare the qualification, not the person
title.zh: 比较限定条件，而不是评判作答者

paragraphs.zh: 可把虚构约定分为“写明的条件”“我假定的条件”“仍需了解的信息”。讨论句是：“我们对原则有分歧，还是对选择是否真实可用的假设不同？”草稿可以不分享；不用问卷代替合同核查，也不要求作答者交出真实交易资料。
paragraphs.en: Separate an invented agreement’s stated terms, assumed terms and missing information. Ask whether the disagreement concerns a principle or an assumption about available choice. Keep the draft private if preferred; use no questionnaire as a contract check and request no real transaction records.

title.en: A shared concern for ownership can lead to disagreement
title.zh: 同样重视权利，仍可能产生不同结论

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的资源主张附有当前持有记录，但讨论还没有交代最初怎样取得、转让是否自愿或是否存在已知不当取得。一位读者可能先关注现在的自主使用，另一位先问纠错需要哪些事实。两人都重视权利，仍可能对主张的论证不同。记录存在与主张正当是两项不同信息，较高均分不认证真实财产权，也不解决自然资源最初取得的理论争议。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a resource claim has a current possession record but leaves initial acquisition, voluntary transfer and possible wrongful taking unspecified. One reader considers present discretion; another asks what rectification requires. Both may value rights while disagreeing about justification. A record and a legitimate claim are different information. A higher mean certifies no real title and resolves no theory of original acquisition.

title.en: Distinguish the principle from missing facts
title.zh: 区分原则分歧与事实缺失

paragraphs.zh: 可以写两栏虚构笔记：“原则上的分歧”“事实上的未知”。把一句“记录足够了”拆开，问它是关于应采用哪条原则，还是关于这次记录包含什么。只澄清例子，不据结果调查真实资产、认定归属或劝人接受某项分配。
paragraphs.en: Draft two columns for an invented case: disagreement about principle and unknown facts. Unpack “the record is enough” into the proposed principle and what this record contains. Clarify the example without investigating assets, assigning ownership or urging acceptance of an allocation from a result.

title.en: Different theories can require an explanation
title.zh: 不同理论也可能要求说明理由

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构公共机构提出一项有约束力的限制，给出的说明只有“出发点很好”。两位读者都想知道实际理由，却可能分别持有较窄或较广的公共职责观。共同要求理由，并不能确定两人的政治身份一致；提出理由后，理由是否充分、事实是否成立及救济是否可用，也仍需分别讨论。八题均分没有核查任何真实机构或法律行为，不能代替这些判断。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a public agency proposes a binding restriction with only a statement of good intentions. Two readers ask for reasons while holding narrower or broader views of public responsibilities. That shared request establishes no shared political identity. Adequacy of reasons, supporting facts and available remedies remain separate questions. Eight ratings inspect no actual agency or legal action and replace none of those judgments.

title.en: State the question you would still need answered

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构提案写“提出的理由”“尚未证明的事实”“仍可讨论的原则”。问：“我在要求解释，还是已经认定某个结果？”讨论不必达成一致，也不转成针对真实机构的行动；无需公开分数、指定政党或按结果说服任何人。
paragraphs.en: For an invented proposal, list reasons offered, unestablished facts and principles still to discuss. Ask whether you seek an explanation or have already judged an outcome. Agreement is optional, with no action against real institutions, disclosed scores, party assignment or result-based persuasion.
